baselines.name: CUB stable selection and indexed warp consumer

costs.scope: complete device-resident pipeline; allocation, H2D/D2H and host preparation excluded and disclosed

quality.probe: held-out rich-output omission and two-level source-identity restoration on synthetic records

limitations: deterministic untrained synthetic records, not biological validation
fixed variant order and no complete allocation/H2D/D2H timing
two-level test proves routing identity, not learned information preservation
other input shapes and hardware untested
conclusion: The compacted warp mechanism is correct but did not win the measured device-resident pipeline; evaluated_not_promoted.
